# Faith Meredith

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- **Origin:** Maywater  <sub>[v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Red Rose  <sub>[v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065)</sub>

## Appearance

Faith is described as a beauty who is as pretty as a picture. She wears her glow carelessly and features striking golden-brown eyes, splendid golden-brown curls, crimson cheeks, and slender wrists.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c23 P0](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0000)_

## Personality

Faith is a joyous, heedless, and impulsive tomboy who frequently gets into scrapes. She is quick-tempered and spirited, yet her tempers never last very long. Inspiring, original, and dramatic, she believes the world is a place of laughter rather than tears and refuses to dwell on disagreeable subjects.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029), [v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031), [v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 c5 P72](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0072), [v5 c5 P85](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0085), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c26 P22](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0022)_

## Traits

- tomboyish  <sub>[v5 c2 P29](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0029)</sub>
- heedless and impulsive  <sub>[v5 c2 P31](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0031)</sub>

## Abilities

- dancing and physical playfulness  <sub>[v5 c4 P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 c5 P0](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0000)</sub>
- helping schoolmates with arithmetic sums  <sub>[v5 c10 P38](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0038)</sub>

## Goals

- never to marry a minister  <sub>[v5 c15 P37](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0037)</sub>
- to keep her family from having to move away from Glen St. Mary  <sub>[v5 c15 P36](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0036), [v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038)</sub>

## History

Faith moved from Maywater to Glen St. Mary with her family, bringing along her pet rooster Adam. She befriended the Blythe children and joined them in Rainbow Valley, while also establishing the Good-Conduct Club alongside her siblings to help regulate their behavior. Due to her impulsive nature, she frequently caused local scandals, such as accidentally cleaning house and shaking rugs in the graveyard on a Sunday after confusing the days of the week, and publicizing the error in front of the entire church congregation. Determined to keep her father from being forced out of his pastorate, she successfully confronted Norman Douglas and persuaded him to return to church and pay his subscription. She tied her blue ribbon around Walter Blythe's arm prior to his fight with Dan Reese, and later formed a warm friendship with Rosemary West after confessing her grief over the death of her pet rooster.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P45](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0045), [v5 c4 P46](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0046), [v5 c4 P48](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0048), [v5 c10 P38](../source/v05-c10.md#nw-v05-c10-p0038), [v5 c12 P6](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0006), [v5 c15 P38](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0038), [v5 c16 P60](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0060), [v5 c16 P65](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0065), [v5 c17 P41](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0041), [v5 c20 P17](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0017), [v5 c23 P56](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0056)_

> The world isn’t a vale of tears, Mrs. Taylor. It’s a world of laughter.  <sub>[v5 c4 P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006)</sub>

> Hell is an awful place. Bad people go there when they die and burn in fire for ever and ever and ever.  <sub>[v5 c5 P72](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0072)</sub>

> It’s awful to be minister’s family. Just as soon as you get fond of a place you are torn up by the roots. I’ll never, never, never marry a minister, no matter how nice he is.  <sub>[v5 c15 P37](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0037)</sub>
